wob.translation: abbr. washed overboard （保险业用语）浪击落海的; 浪击落水（指被浪冲出舷外）; washing overboard （货物被）浪击落海; 冲失

wobble.definition:
n. an unsteady rocking motion
v. move unsteadily
wobble.translation:
n. 摆动, 摇晃, 不稳定, 抖动
vi. 摇晃, 摇摆, 游移不定
vt. 使摇摆, 使颤动

wobbleboard.translation: 晃动板（原澳大利亚土著乐器, 晃动发低音）

wobbled.definition:
v move unsteadily
v move sideways or in an unsteady way
v tremble or shake
wobbled.translation: v. <使>晃动( wobble的过去式和过去分词 ); <使>摇摆不定; 抖动; 颤动

wobbler.translation: n. 摇摇晃晃的人, 思想动摇的人

wobblers.definition:
plural of wobbler
n. something that wobbles
wobblers.translation: (wobbler 的复数) n. 摇摇晃晃的人, 思想动摇的人

wobbles.definition:
n an unsteady rocking motion
v move unsteadily
v move sideways or in an unsteady way
v tremble or shake
wobbles.translation:
n. <使>晃动( wobble的名词复数 ); <使>摇摆不定; 抖动; 颤动
v. <使>晃动( wobble的第三人称单数 ); <使>摇摆不定; 抖动; 颤动

wobblies.definition:
plural of wobbly
n. a member of the Industrial Workers of the World
wobblies.translation: (wobbly 的复数) a. 摆动的, 不稳定的

wobbliness.translation: n. wobbly（东摇西摆的；歪歪斜斜的；勃然大怒, 怒不可遏）的变形

wobbling.translation: 摆动, 颤动, 摇摆

wobblings.definition:
plural of wobbling
s. (of sound) fluctuating unsteadily
wobblings.translation: (wobbling 的复数) 摆动, 颤动, 摇摆

wobbly.definition: n. a member of the Industrial Workers of the World
wobbly.translation: a. 摆动的, 不稳定的

wobbulate.translation: 频率摆动, 射线偏斜, 射束微摆

wobegone.translation: a. 悲哀的, 忧愁的,寒碜的

wobs.translation: (wob 的第三人称 -s形式) abbr. washed overboard （保险业用语）浪击落海的; 浪击落水（指被浪冲出舷外）; washing overboard （货物被）浪击落海; 冲失

woburn.translation: n. 沃本（美国马萨诸塞州东部城市）
